db_dir.description: Directory where incron stores its internal database and state files

max_events.description: Maximum number of inotify events queued per user; helps prevent memory exhaustion

recursive.description: Enable recursive inotify watches (i.e., watch subdirectories automatically); disable for security in untrusted environments

max_watches.description: Hard limit on the number of inotify watches per user (system-wide limit is usually higher)

log_dest.description: Where to send incron log messages: either 'syslog' (recommended) or 'file' to a custom path

log_file.description: Path to the log file when log_dest is set to 'file'; ignored otherwise

log_level.description: Verbosity level: 0 (none), 1 (errors), 2 (warnings), 3 (info), 4 (debug); higher levels produce more verbose logs

exclude_users.description: List of system or untrusted users explicitly denied access to incrontab

include_users.description: If non-empty, *only* these users may use incrontab (whitelist mode); leave empty to allow all users except those in EXCLUDE_USERS
